chapters.title: Lock in, fall off, lock in, repeat
Your mind is a collection of survival strategies, that’s why it’s so hard to change
You need a reason with extremely high gravitational pull, and when that one fades, you must find another.
You need to become brutally aware of who you don’t want to become.
You need to change your environment faster than the identity can recalibrate.
You need to increase the gap between impulse and response.
Winning the game is how you discover it’s the wrong game
